name: No behavioural transaction monitoring rules
description: No documented thresholds for layering, structuring, velocity, geography.

name: No EDD trigger policy
description: PEPs and high-risk-jurisdiction customers handled identically to standard.

name: Stale customer due diligence
description: No periodic CDD refresh; risk profile drifts over years.

name: Stale sanctions screening lists
description: Sanctions lists refreshed only weekly or rely on manual upload.

name: No fuzzy / phonetic name matching
description: Sanctions screening uses exact match only — trivial spelling variations bypass.

name: No confirmation of payee on outbound
description: Beneficiary name not validated against account number, enabling APP fraud.

name: No behavioural fraud detection
description: Card and account fraud detection rules limited to static thresholds.

name: No 3-D Secure / SCA on card flows
description: Strong customer authentication absent or commonly waived.

name: No fraud signal at onboarding
description: No device, behavioural, or velocity checks during account opening.

name: No money-mule detection rules
description: No rapid-in / rapid-out, structured-deposits, or unusual-counterparty rules.

name: No trade surveillance
description: No automated detection of front-running, spoofing, layering on dealer book.

name: No personal-account-dealing policy
description: Trading staff allowed personal trading without disclosure / pre-approval.

name: No correspondent-bank EDD
description: Correspondent relationships established without Wolfsberg-style due diligence.

name: No nested account detection
description: Cannot identify when correspondent's underlying customer transacts as if they were a direct customer.
